hero_title:
Hi, I'm Anvarjon.
I build reliable backend systems.
hero_desc: I build REST APIs, automated workflows and production-grade backend architecture — using Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and n8n.
about_title: I build backend systems that are reliable and well-structured
about_p1: As a Python backend engineer and system integrator, I work on REST API services, database architecture, and automated workflows. I've built production-grade projects with Django and FastAPI, design data with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, deploy with Docker, and automate processes between services using n8n.
about_p2: I value clean code, clear architecture, and systems that work reliably in production — not just "it works", but "it works reliably".
